items.text: I've been working hard on some things behind the scenes, and today I'm really happy to finally share one of them with you!
Dark Deity 2 now supports Korean interface and subtitles.
This is only the beginning, as we're continuing to work on additional localizations so that even more communities can join us on this adventure.
With this patch we are adding 3 highly requested randomizer options that you can opt into when starting a new campaign, which are as follows:
Random Passives: When promoting or class changing, units will receive a random passive in the slot for that class tier
Random Abilities: When promoting or class changing, units will receive a random ability in the slot for that class tier
Random Loot: When killing an enemy with loot or looting a chest, that loot will be randomized

I think these are our most fun randomizer additions yet, can't wait to see what goofy things happen in your campaigns with these now available! I am a big fan personally of random loot in particular, as it really changes the meta progression in significant ways.
Significantly improved performance optimization in base and premap, particularly for lower end devices
Significantly improved performance optimization in general gameplay, particularly for lower end devices
Fixed a variety of issues with unit interaction
Fixed an issue where the rings menu was incorrectly displaying multiple rings in the same slot

improved performance optimization in the world map and base
improved performance optimization for on-map gameplay
Fixed an issue that allowed the final boss to move in unintended ways, potentially crashing the game
Fixed a variety of issues with unit interaction and battlesaving
Fixed issues with Wreathed in Flame and post battle interaction
Fixed issues with Repulsor Shield and post battle interaction
Fixed issues with Bleed and post battle interaction
Fixed issues with units dying on Demonic and not causing a game over in certain cases
Fixed an issue with the side objective for 0 unit deaths not ticking in certain cases
Fixed an issue where battlesaving and loading in certain circumstances could lead to not getting the proper post level scene
Fixed a crash where giving inputs to both attack and cancel action could crash the game under certain circumstances
Fixed an issue where clicking through levelup screens could alter the fast forward functionality as well
Fixed an issue with the titan rune decreasing accuracy by the wrong amount
Fixed an issue where celerity was not applying its power reduction
Fixed an issue with the vicious rune having slightly incorrect value reductions
Fixed an issue where divine flow was decrementing stacks for ALL units with the ability active
Fixed a potential crash with the game trying to draw non existent enemies to the screen
Fixed an issue where casting an ability that brought you back to the action menu could default to the wrong menu slot and make it easy to accidentally end turn instead of acting
Fixed an issue with the hurricane ring not applying its effects when equipped in prebattle
Changed one of the upgrades for 'Bloodstroke' so that it doesn't have 3 of the same option

There are some issues right now with post-battle damage effects like bleed and 'wreathed in flame', as well as when both units in the combat die due to either those effects or 'repulsor shield'. Particularly this can bypass the death scripts and cause some unintended functionality like the resurrection ability failing to target that unit or not receiving a wound/ending the level on Demonic difficulty. If you run into one of these things - I am working on getting it fixed but want to be careful around pushing changes for it to the live build since there are so many different ways that these scripts interact. When I've had time to properly test it and make sure all is well I'll have a fix out for it soon!
Fixed an issue where the new options from patch 1.09 were loading their functionality in reverse (auto fast forward was loading the longer levelups option state and vice versa)
Fixed an issue where the water in chapter 25 could be teleported onto
Fixed an issue with the Ravager Winds snaring upgrade applying blind
Fixed an issue with the Astral Reckoning snaring upgrade not applying
Fixed an issue with the Breaker snaring upgrade not applying
Fixed an issue with the Lightning Strike snaring upgrade not applying
Fixed an issue with the Enchant Weapon cleansing upgrade not functioning
Fixed an issue with chapter 12 not ending upon defeating the route boss (the big one) - which could also then lead to a crash.
Fixed an issue where buying the lowest item in the shop then attempting to buy the empty slot could cause a crash on controller
Fixed an issue where selling the lowest item in the shop then attempting to sell the empty slot could cause a crash on controller
Took a small ~1 day hiatus from bug fixing to add some of the most highly requested features, and will be returning so fixing things up now! Hope you have fun with the new additions!
There is now a toggleable option to make it so your levelups don't auto advance. Stare at them as long as you like!

There is now a toggleable option to make it so fast forward is automatically on. It is still changeable with a click, but for any case where fast forward is appropriate, it will begin on with this option toggled.
Shuffled Unit Aptitudes: This randomly adjusts each individual unit's aptitudes, swapping them around randomly.
Shuffled Unit Passives: This creates a pool of all 20 unit passives and assigns them at random to the team.
Shuffled Unit Personals: This creates a pool of all 20 unit personal active abilities and assigns them at random to the team.

Keep in mind that these new campaign customization options are fairly experimental, so you may run into untested interactions with them. I'll be sure to get anything serious with the mode patched up ASAP if it pops up, just make sure to report it in the Steam forums or our discord!
Small patch today with one very important fix for the final chapter as I work on better itemizing what I need to get through this week and planning out some work looking further ahead.
Fixed an issue with the final chapter where the game could get stuck without completing the level
Fixed an issue where illuminate wasn't applying its buff immediately
The priest enemy in chapter 10 with incorrect stats is now properly scaled
Fixed a tooltip issue with the elemental ring

I'm still prioritizing bug fixing for now but there are a couple small options I'm starting work on to add this week that have been heavily requested. These are not live in THIS patch but are coming soon.
Option to have levelups NOT auto advance so you can have more time to process the info
Option to have fast forwarding be on by default without needing to click

items.text: Fixed an issue where movement range could persist through taking an action and cause units to run in place in odd ways and potentially crash the game in certain circumstances. This was one of the more commonly experienced game breaking issues so if you ran into something similar there is a really strong chance it was this.
Changed the text of the kindling ring to better suit its effect
Fixed an issue with enemies not spawning with correct stats when the random enemies customization was live
Fixed an issue with the radiance ring applying blind to allies in AOE Restoration spells
Fixed an issue where class changing could override menu functionality and crash the game
Fixed an issue where over 100 xp could be gained, resulting in a lost levelup
Fixed a crash where poisoned units with mastery below 0 could cause ability scaling to break. Poison no longer reduces Mastery below 0.

Fixed an issue that allowed you to take attacks and movement actions before the unit made it to their proper tile, leaving them out of place and glitched if animations were off or a movement option was used. This was causing a majority of unit desync issues and a variety of crashes on maps with 'jump' tiles.
Fixed an issue with pet commands not applying their effects with animations off
Fixed an issue where counter attacking with animations off was missing certain on-hit effects
Fixed an issue where movement grids weren't properly clearing when a frame was skipped, leading to units disappearing
Fixed an issue where stormrider casted offmap could crash the game
It's day 4 now of Dark Deity 2 being out, and I just want to take a second to say a huge thank you to everyone playing the game!

It’s been a blast hearing about the story choices you’re making, the unit builds you're experimenting with, and the team comps you're theorycrafting. Your feedback, bug reports, and support have been making a big impact. It’s also been so rewarding to see the game hit New & Trending on Steam and already pass 260 reviews. Thank you for helping make that happen!

I just pushed Patch 1.05 (my fifth patch in four days) as I’ve been hard at work to stay on top of your reports. I am doing my best to get through everything and you've all been immensely helpful already. I’m prioritizing the highest-impact bugs (like crashes and freezes) first, then I’ll be diving deeper into more general feedback. Please keep the reports coming; every message helps, and I’m doing what I can to make sure I read through every report and piece of feedback.
If you want to see the previous patch notes, you can find them by checking out The Steam News Hub for the Game here!

notes.title: The 1.05 patch notes for this evening are as follows

items.text: Fixed an issue on Steam Deck where the internal pointer could get stuck on the codex button and stop base menus from properly functioning
Fixed a crash with AOE abilities in certain map circumstances
Fixed a crash in certain later game prebattles when switching between menus
Added in a failsafe for possible freezing on critical hits on some systems, should solve any edge cases remaining
Fixed an issue where call the storm was leaving a 0.00 decimal reading into the level stats
Fixed an issue where the text for skipping cutscenes was not properly dropping down on some resolutions
Fixed an issue where you could crash the game by trying to sell an empty weapon slot
Fixed an issue where you could buy bugged weapons by buying an empty weapon slot

Once again, thank you all so much for the love and support. It truly means the world to me, and seeing the response so far has been amazing. If you’re enjoying your time with Dark Deity 2, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Early reviews are hugely helpful for indie games and it’s been awesome reading through your thoughts so far.
If you’ve got feedback or run into any issues, hop into the Discord or drop a post in the Steam Discussion Bug Report Thread. More updates are on the way!

-Fixed an issue where phantom units from the class tree could persist off the map, which led to a variety of different issues that seemed like they might be coming from something else (most notably, unit deaths with the unit not actually dying, some strange enemy targeting, and the controller unit cycling getting bugged out)

-Fixed an issue where battlesaves could lead to the post-level decision cutscene being skipped (going to have some more testing for this once build is live, could require another fix tomorrow to catch all possibilities)
-Fixed an issue where 'cleansing' upgrades didn't function correctly if taken as the second upgrade.
-Fixed an issue where some abilities 'cleansing' upgrade didn't function at all
-Fixed an issue where weapons in the shop could become unsellable past a certain point
-Fixed an issue where campaign customization could select multiple options at a time
Fixed Challenge: Rescuing to no longer cause a game over on end of turn count
Fixed a crash where promoting gwyn in certain rare circumstances could terminate the game

Fixed some crashes resulting from units existing in between tiles after movement (there are some more issues remaining to be fixed that are of this nature, so if you run into one please let me know in the forums or discord!)
Fixed the Titan rune displaying the wrong tooltip
Fixed the tooltip for Defensive Stance to show the right severity
Fixed the shop not resetting to the first slot when switching tabs on controller
Fixed an issue where units could retain their experience when starting a new save
Fixed an issue where you could a sell more copies of a weapon than you had
Fixed a typo with the warded empowerment

Lots of issues left to fix but I'm doing my best to get through them quickly! I really appreciate all the bug reports you're dropping, it's been making it much easier for me to find and fix things quickly. As always thanks for your patience, and I'll be working on the next patch ASAP! Planning to continue to drop them once a day in the morning while lots of issues still persist.
